inspector.purpose: Development-only controls for timeline, readiness, failure and reduced-motion inspection; not production app interactions

interaction: A to B to C before asset readiness: only C may commit
Failed image decode: keep the previous scene and expose retry
Repeated retry, target replacement, unmount during loading
OS reduced motion and text scale changes
Pointer exit/reset, scroll boundaries, narrow and wide viewports
visual: Portrait crop and focal subject visibility
Text contrast, large text, reading order and controls
No seams at entry and endpoint
Actual performance on the target device
plan.evidence: Record tool version, scene hash, target device, commands and exit codes, timestamped screenshots, and reviewed interaction steps. A successful build or a scripted pointer video is not visual or interaction acceptance.
